description: Source code for the ModalView widget in the Kivy framework, including class definition, methods, and example usage.

classes.name: ModalView
classes.description: A widget class for creating modal views that cover the main window, with customizable background, overlay, and event handling.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Displays the modal view with optional animation, binding to window resize and keyboard events.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Closes the modal view with optional fade-out animation, unbinding events.

methods.name: _align_center
methods.description: Centers the modal view within the window.

methods.name: on_touch_down
methods.description: Handles touch down events, determines if touch started inside the widget.

methods.name: on_touch_up
methods.description: Handles touch up events, dismisses if auto_dismiss is True and touch started outside.

methods.name: on__anim_alpha
methods.description: Callback for animation progress, removes widget when alpha reaches 0.

methods.name: _real_remove_widget
methods.description: Removes widget from window and unbinds events.

methods.name: _handle_keyboard
methods.description: Handles keyboard events, dismisses on escape key if auto_dismiss is True.
